sections.title: Habit and flowering
sections.text: Cornus mas, cornelian cherry, is a spreading shrub or small tree reaching about 5 m in height and width. Its small yellow flowers appear on bare twigs in late winter, before the leaves.

sections.title: Fruit and comparison
sections.text: The flowers develop into elongated red drupes, harvested for preserves and drinks. The plate correctly shows the early flowers and elongated fruits. Unlike common dogwood, Cornus sanguinea, it has yellow flowers and red fruits rather than white clusters followed by black fruits.
